Run one step of the Atlantis calibration model

run_model.Rd

Model function called by calibrar at every parameter proposal. Receives a log-scale parameter vector, back-transforms it via exp(), writes a parameter snapshot CSV, edits the relevant entries in the Atlantis biology (and harvest) parameter files, executes the simulation via a shell script, reads the outputs, and returns a named list of modeled indicators for comparison against observations.

calibrar calls this function as run_model(par, ...), where ... are the extra arguments given to make_objfn. It runs in the working directory set by calibrar (a copy of control$master), so all file names are relative to that directory.

The parameters edited are those in names, as created from the parameter table by create_target_files_biomass. Each factor multiplies the original value(s) in the .prm file (see edit_param_factor). Parameter names in names must follow these conventions (other names stop with an error):

  • mum, BHalpha, BHbeta, KDENR, C and E: <type>_<Code>_factor (e.g. "mum_FPS_factor"), edited in the biology parameter file.

  • mQ and mL: <Code>_<type>_factor (e.g. "ZS_mQ_factor"), edited in the biology parameter file.

  • mfc: mfc_<Code>_factor, edited as mFC_<Code> in the harvest parameter file.

The shell script that runs Atlantis is the only file with extension .sh in the working directory, and the biology and harvest parameter files are those given to its options -b and -h (see read_sh_file). The edited parameters are written to these same files, so Atlantis runs with them. The first time run_model() runs in a directory, each original file is copied to <file>.original; the factors are always applied to the values in this copy, so they are not applied twice when a directory is reused.

The output list has one element per target in variables, matched by the suffix of the target name:

  • <Code>_biomass: total biomass of the group.

  • <Name><age>_w: mean weight at age.

  • <Name>_catch: total catch of the group, summed over fleets.

  • <Name>_Nums: matrix of abundance with one column per age class.

Only the last dt.timeseries time steps of each output are returned, to match the length of the targets. If the simulation crashed or stopped before tstop, all outputs are zeros.

Usage

run_model(
  param,
  names,
  variables,
  prefix,
  fg.file,
  biom.indx,
  run.prm,
  dt.timeseries,
  param.file = "calibration-parameters.csv",
  track.path = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

param

Numeric vector of parameters in log scale. Back-transformed via exp() before use.

names

Character vector of parameter names parallel to param.

variables

Character vector. Names of the calibration targets (setup$variable), which are the names of the returned list.

prefix

Character. Prefix path for the Atlantis NetCDF output files (e.g. "outputFolder/AMPS").

fg.file

Character. Name of the functional groups CSV file.

biom.indx

Character. Relative path to the biomass index text file written by the run (e.g. "outputFolder/AMPS_OUTBiomIndx.txt"), used to detect whether the simulation completed.

run.prm

Character. Name of the Atlantis run parameter file, used to read tstop.

dt.timeseries

Integer. Number of time steps in each target.

param.file

Character. Name of the CSV file written with the back-transformed parameter values at each run. Default: "calibration-parameters.csv".

track.path

Character. Absolute path of the folder where the parameter files used in each run are saved (see keep_track_prm). If NULL (default), they are not saved.

...

Other arguments passed by calibrar (e.g. forcing), not used.

Value

A named list of modeled output indicators, one element per target in variables.
